content.description: Illustration showing fuel pump location and check connector in engine bay

content.text: NOTE: Do not start the engine.

items: (b) Short both terminals of the fuel pump check connector.

content.description: Illustration showing fuel pump and pressure regulator location with check connector

items: (c) Check that there is a pressure in the hose to the cold start injector.

content.text: NOTE: At this time, you will hear fuel return noise from the pressure regulator.

items: (d) Remove service wire and install the rubber cap to the check terminal.

content.text: If no fuel pressure, check the following parts.

content.description: Illustration showing cold start injector location in engine bay

items: (a) Check the battery voltage above 12 volts.
(c) Disconnect the wiring connector from the cold start injector.

content.description: Illustration showing cold start injector hose and union bolt location

items: (d) Put a suitable container or shop towel under rear end of the delivery pipe.
(e) Slowly loosen the union bolt of the cold start injector hose and remove the bolt and two gaskets from the delivery pipe.
(f) Drain the fuel in the delivery pipe.
